# Variable cleaning
```{r}
data<- data %>% 
  filter(!is.na(DEM_SETT_code) & DEM_SETT_code != -8) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(WB_Satisfied) & WB_Satisfied != -8) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(WB_ThingsWorthwhile) & WB_ThingsWorthwhile != -8) %>%
  filter(!is.na(WB_Happy) & WB_Happy != -8) %>%
  filter(!is.na(WB_Anxious) & WB_Anxious != -8) %>%
  filter(!is.na(DEM_Gender) & DEM_Gender != -8) %>%
  filter(!is.na(DEM_Age_Band) & DEM_Age_Band != -8) %>%
  filter(!is.na(DEM_Ethnicity) & !DEM_Ethnicity %in% c(-6, -8)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(DEM_Employment) & DEM_Employment != -8) %>%
  filter(!is.na(DEM_MaritalStatus) & !DEM_MaritalStatus %in% c(-6, -8)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(WB_EnoughT) & WB_EnoughT != -8) %>%
  filter(!is.na(HE_IllnessActivity) & !HE_IllnessActivity %in% c(-7, -8))
```

# Confidence and structural testing of well-being
```{r}
df$WB_Anxious_rev <- 10 - data$WB_Anxious

WB_items <- df %>%
  dplyr::select(WB_Satisfied, WB_ThingsWorthwhile,
                WB_Happy,     WB_Anxious_rev) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ as.numeric(as.character(.))))

# Cronbach α
alpha_res <- psych::alpha(WB_items, check.keys = TRUE)
alpha_res$total$raw_alpha
alpha_res$item.total

# McDonald ω_t
omega_res <- omega(WB_items, nfactors = 1, check.keys = TRUE)
omega_res$omega.t

# Correlation
cor(WB_items, use="pairwise.complete.obs")
```

```{r}
# Simple average method (Not adopted)
df$Wellbeing_average <- rowMeans(df[, c("WB_Satisfied", 
                                          "WB_Happy", 
                                          "WB_ThingsWorthwhile", 
                                          "WB_Anxious_rev")],
                                 na.rm = TRUE)

summary(df$Wellbeing_average)

sd_val <- sd(df$Wellbeing_average) 
sd_val
```

```{r}
shapiro_res <- shapiro.test(df$Wellbeing_average)
shapiro_res

qqnorm(df$Wellbeing_average, main = "Q-Q Plot: Wellbeing_average")
qqline(df$Wellbeing_average)
```

```{r}
group_stats <- df %>%
  group_by(Urban_Rural_Type) %>%     
  summarize(
    n    = n(),
    mean = mean(Wellbeing_average, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(Wellbeing_average,   na.rm = TRUE)
  )
group_stats 
```

```{r}
t_res <- t.test(Wellbeing_average ~ Urban_Rural_Type,
                var.equal = FALSE,    
                data = df)

t_res$p.value 
```

```{r}
plot(density(df$Wellbeing_average, na.rm = TRUE), 
     main = "Kernel Density of Wellbeing Index", 
     xlab = "Wellbeing Index")
```


```{r}
# Confirmatory Factor Analysis (Adopted)
df <- df %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.labelled), ~as.numeric(.)))

WB_model <- '
  Wellbeing =~ WB_Satisfied + WB_ThingsWorthwhile + WB_Happy + WB_Anxious_rev
'
fit <- cfa(WB_model, data = df, std.lv = TRUE, missing = "FIML")
summary(fit, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)

df$Wellbeing_Factor <- lavPredict(fit, method = "regression")
```
```{r}
loadings_table <- parameterEstimates(fit, standardized = TRUE) %>%
  filter(op == "=~") %>% 
  select(Indicator = rhs,
         Std_Loading = std.all,
         SE = se,
         p_value = pvalue) %>%
  mutate(R2 = inspect(fit, "r2")[Indicator])

loadings_table
```

```{r}
labs_cfa <- c(
  Wellbeing            = "Wellbeing",
  WB_Satisfied         = "Life satisfaction",
  WB_ThingsWorthwhile  = "Worthwhile",

)
```

# Digital Inclusion
```{r}
int_vars <- names(df)[startsWith(names(df), "INT")]
print(int_vars)
```

### Digital skill (CFA)
```{r}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    skill_financial = as.integer(rowSums(across(c(INTUse_Activ_Finances,
                                                  INTUse_Activ_Selling)), na.rm=TRUE) > 0),
    skill_learning  = as.integer(rowSums(across(c(INTUse_Activ_OLLearning,
                                                  INTUse_Activ_Learning,
                                                  INTUse_Activ_ExClass)), na.rm=TRUE) > 0),
    skill_travel    = as.integer(rowSums(across(c(INTUse_Activ_BookTravel,
                                                  INTUse_Activ_BookAccomm)), na.rm=TRUE) > 0),
    skill_comm      = as.integer(rowSums(
      across(c(SOC_ChildVideocall, SOC_ChildPhone, SOC_ChildMail, SOC_ChildText,
               SOC_FMVideocall, SOC_FMPhone, SOC_FMMail, SOC_FMText)),
      na.rm=TRUE) > 0)
  )

skills_vars <- c("skill_financial","skill_learning",
                 "skill_travel","skill_comm")

df[skills_vars] <- lapply(df[skills_vars], function(x){
  x <- ifelse(x %in% c(0,1), x, NA)
  factor(x, levels=c(0,1), ordered=TRUE)
})

model_skills <- "
Digital_skills =~ skill_financial + skill_learning + skill_travel +
           skill_comm
"

fit_skills_wlsmv <- cfa(model_skills,
                        data = df,
                        ordered = skills_vars,
                        estimator = 'WLSMV',
                        std.lv = TRUE,
                        parameterization = 'theta')

summary(fit_skills_wlsmv, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
```

```{r}
df$Skill_count4 <- rowSums(sapply(df[, c("skill_financial","skill_learning",
                                         "skill_travel","skill_comm")],
                                  function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x))), na.rm=TRUE)

df$Skill_factor <- lavPredict(fit_skills_wlsmv)
cor(df$Skill_count4, df$Skill_factor, use="pairwise")
```

```{r}
df$Skill_factor <- as.numeric(df$Skill_factor)
ggplot(df, aes(x = Skill_count4, y = Skill_factor)) +

  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 21, size = 3, fill = "white", color = "black") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "darkred") +
  labs(
    x = "Skill Count (0–4)",
    y = "Digital Skills Factor Score",
    title = "Comparison between Skill Count and CFA-Derived Factor Score"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Access Device (PCA)
```{r}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Device_count = rowSums(select(., INTUse_Devices_Desktop,
                                     INTUse_Devices_Laptop,
                                     INTUse_Devices_Tablet,
                                     INTUse_Devices_Smartphone), na.rm = TRUE),
    Device_help = rowSums(select(., INTUse_Help_NewDevice), na.rm = TRUE),
    Freq_use = case_when(
      INTUse_Times %in% 1:3 ~ 1,
      INTUse_Times %in% 4:6 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

z_cols <- c("Device_count","Device_help","Freq_use")
df <- df %>% mutate(across(all_of(z_cols), ~ as.numeric(scale(.)), .names = "{.col}_z"))
```

```{r}
dev_raw <- df %>% select(all_of(z_cols)) %>% na.omit()
R1 <- cor(dev_raw)
cortest.bartlett(R1, n = nrow(dev_raw))
KMO(R1)
```

```{r}
pca_data_dev <- df %>%
  select(all_of(z_cols)) %>%
  na.omit() 

pca_device <- prcomp(pca_data_dev, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)

summary(pca_device)
loadings_dev <- pca_device$rotation
print(loadings_dev)
```

```{r}
df$AccessDevice_PCA <- NA_real_
df$AccessDevice_PCA[complete.cases(df[z_cols])] <- pca_device$x[,1]

summary(df$AccessDevice_PCA_z)
```

### Constructing Digital Inclusion Indicator
```{r}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    DigitalInclusion = ifelse(
      rowSums(!is.na(cbind(AccessConnect_PCA_z, AccessDevice_PCA_z, Skill_factor_z))) >= 2,
      rowMeans(cbind(AccessConnect_PCA_z, AccessDevice_PCA_z, Skill_factor_z), na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    )
  )
sum(is.na(df$DigitalInclusion))       
mean(is.na(df$DigitalInclusion)) * 100 

df$DigitalInclusion_z <- as.numeric(scale(df$DigitalInclusion))
summary(df$DigitalInclusion_z)
```

```{r}
ggplot(df, aes(x = DigitalInclusion_z)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..),
```

```{r}
m  <- lm(Wellbeing_factor ~ DigitalInclusion_z * Urban_Rural_Type, data = df)
co <- coef(m); V <- vcov(m)

lev <- levels(df$Urban_Rural_Type) 

if (paste0("DigitalInclusion_z:Urban_Rural_Type", lev[2]) %in% names(co)) {
  int_name <- paste0("DigitalInclusion_z:Urban_Rural_Type", lev[2])
} else {
  int_name <- paste0("Urban_Rural_Type", lev[2], ":DigitalInclusion_z")
}

b1     <- co["DigitalInclusion_z"]
se_b1  <- sqrt(V["DigitalInclusion_z","DigitalInclusion_z"])
b3     <- co[int_name] 
var_o  <- V["DigitalInclusion_z","DigitalInclusion_z"] + V[int_name,int_name] +
          2*V["DigitalInclusion_z", int_name]
se_o   <- sqrt(var_o)

if (lev[1] == "Urban") {
  urb_est <- b1;             urb_lwr <- b1 - 1.96*se_b1;  urb_upr <- b1 + 1.96*se_b1
  rur_est <- b1 + b3;        rur_lwr <- rur_est - 1.96*se_o; rur_upr <- rur_est + 1.96*se_o
} else {
  rur_est <- b1;             rur_lwr <- b1 - 1.96*se_b1;  rur_upr <- b1 + 1.96*se_b1
  urb_est <- b1 + b3;        urb_lwr <- urb_est - 1.96*se_o; urb_upr <- urb_est + 1.96*se_o
}

lab_urban <- sprintf("Urban slope = %.3f  [%.3f, %.3f]", urb_est, urb_lwr, urb_upr)
lab_rural <- sprintf("Rural slope = %.3f  [%.3f, %.3f]", rur_est, rur_lwr, rur_upr)

xr <- range(df$DigitalInclusion_z, na.rm = TRUE)
yr <- range(df$Wellbeing_factor,  na.rm = TRUE)
x_pos  <- xr[2] - 0.02 * diff(xr)
y_base <- yr[1] + 0.06 * diff(yr)
y_gap  <- 0.12 * diff(yr) 

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(df, aes(x = DigitalInclusion_z, y = Wellbeing_factor, 
               color = Urban_Rural_Type, fill = Urban_Rural_Type)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2, shape = 16) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, fullrange = TRUE,
              alpha = 0.3, size = 0.9, aes(linetype = Urban_Rural_Type)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Urban" = "#1C1C1C", "Rural" = "#4B4E6D")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = c("Urban" = "#2C3E50", "Rural" = "#7E5C3A")) +
  labs(
    x = "Digital Inclusion Index (z-score)",
    y = "Wellbeing",
    color = "Residence Type",
    fill  = "Residence Type",
    linetype = "Residence Type",
    caption = "Shaded areas = 95% CIs. Wider band for Rural mainly reflects its smaller sample / sparser high-DI data."
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = x_pos, y = y_base,         label = lab_rural,
           hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 3.6, color = "#4B4E6D") +
  annotate("text", x = x_pos, y = y_base + y_gap, label = lab_urban,
           hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 3.6, color = "#1C1C1C") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey30"),
    plot.title   = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10)
  )
```

# Robustness Checks
```{r}
### OLS
lm_fit <- lm(
  Wellbeing_factor ~ DigitalInclusion_z +
                     DI_x_Urban_Rural +
                     DEM_Age_Band +
                     DEM_Gender +
                     Economic_Activity_Status +
                     Living_Status + 
                     HE_IllnessActivity +
                     WB_EnoughTime,
  data = df
)

vcov_hc3 <- vcovHC(lm_fit, type = "HC3")

coeftest(lm_fit, vcov. = vcov_hc3)
```

```{r}
vif(lm_fit)

resid_values <- rstandard(lm_fit)
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
hist(resid_values,
     main = "Histogram of Standardized Residuals",
     xlab = "Standardized Residual")
qqnorm(resid_values); qqline(resid_values)

bptest(lm_fit)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(gtsummary)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Urban_Rural_Type = factor(Urban_Rural_Type_num, levels = c(1, 0), labels = c("Urban", "Rural")),
    DEM_Gender = factor(DEM_Gender, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("Male", "Female")),
    DEM_Age_Band_grouped = case_when(
      DEM_Age_Band %in% c(1, 2) ~ "50–59years",
      DEM_Age_Band %in% c(3, 4) ~ "60–69years",
      DEM_Age_Band %in% c(5, 6) ~ "70+years",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    DEM_Age_Band_grouped = factor(DEM_Age_Band_grouped, levels = c("50–59years", "60–69years", "70+years")),
    Economic_Activity_Status = factor(Economic_Activity_Status),
    Living_Status = factor(Living_Status),
    Ethnic_Group = factor(Ethnic_Group),
    IllnessActivity = factor(IllnessActivity),
    WB_EnoughTime = factor(WB_EnoughTime),
    DigitalInclusion     = as.numeric(DigitalInclusion),
    Wellbeing_Factor     = as.numeric(Wellbeing_Factor),
    WB_Satisfied         = as.numeric(WB_Satisfied),
    WB_ThingsWorthwhile  = as.numeric(WB_ThingsWorthwhile),
    WB_Happy             = as.numeric(WB_Happy),
    WB_Anxious_rev       = as.numeric(WB_Anxious_rev),
    AccessConnect_PCA  = as.numeric(AccessConnect_PCA),
    AccessDevice_PCA   = as.numeric(AccessDevice_PCA),
    Skill_factor       = as.numeric(Skill_factor)
  )

df %>%
  select(
    Urban_Rural_Type,
    DigitalInclusion,
    Wellbeing_Factor,
    WB_Satisfied,
    WB_ThingsWorthwhile,
    WB_Happy,
    WB_Anxious_rev,
    AccessConnect_PCA,
    AccessDevice_PCA,
    Skill_factor,
    DEM_Gender,
    DEM_Age_Band_grouped,
    Economic_Activity_Status,
    Living_Status,
    Ethnic_Group,
    IllnessActivity,
    WB_EnoughTime
  ) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    by = Urban_Rural_Type,
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
    digits = all_continuous() ~ 2,
    label = list(
      DigitalInclusion ~ "Digital Inclusion",
      Wellbeing_Factor ~ "Subjective Wellbeing ",
      WB_Satisfied ~ "Life Satisfaction",
      WB_ThingsWorthwhile ~ "Life Worthwhile",
      WB_Happy ~ "Happiness",
      WB_Anxious_rev ~ "Low Anxiety",
      AccessConnect_PCA ~ "Internet Connectivity",
      AccessDevice_PCA ~ "Device Access",
      Skill_factor ~ "Digital Skills",
      DEM_Gender ~ "Gender",
      DEM_Age_Band_grouped ~ "Age Group",
      Economic_Activity_Status ~ "Economic Activity",
      Living_Status ~ "Living Status",
      Ethnic_Group ~ "Ethnic Group",
      IllnessActivity ~ "Health Limitation", 
      WB_EnoughTime ~ "Enough Time"
    ),
    missing = "no"
  ) %>%
  add_overall() %>%
  modify_header(label = "**Variable**") %>%
  modify_caption("**Table 4.1. Descriptive Statistics by Urban-Rural Group**")
```
